title: Milan Cathedral
blurb: The Duomo di Milano in Candoglia marble: 158.6 m of Italian Gothic begun in 1386, with 135 spires, more than 3,400 statues, and the gilded Madonnina at 108.5 m.

systems.name: West facade
systems.description: The west front with five portals, bronze doors, great windows and gable.

systems.name: Nave
systems.description: The five-aisled nave with side walls, windows, clerestory and roof.

systems.name: Flying buttresses
systems.description: The flying buttresses carrying the nave vault thrust to outer piers.

systems.name: Transept and apse
systems.description: The transept arms and the polygonal apse chapels at the east end.

systems.name: Crossing tower
systems.description: The octagonal tiburio over the crossing.

systems.name: Spires
systems.description: The 135 spires crowning the roofs, led by the 108.5 m main spire.

systems.name: Statuary
systems.description: The facade niches, the 96 gargoyles and the gilded Madonnina.

systems.name: Interior
systems.description: The floor, nave colonnades, high altar and choir.
